tabConfigDesc0: Switches network settings automatically based on what you're doing.
optAutoModeExt: PingPimp watches the app you open and changes network settings by itself. Playing a game → Game mode. Downloading → Download mode. No manual changes needed.
optAutoDnsMobileDesc: Private DNS used while on mobile data.
optAutoDnsMobileExt: Sets which encrypted DNS is used when you're on mobile data. Only works when Smart Auto Mode is on. Choose 'Default' to follow your system DNS.
optAutoDnsWifiDesc: Private DNS used while on WiFi.
optAutoDnsWifiExt: Sets which encrypted DNS is used when you're on WiFi. Only works when Smart Auto Mode is on. Choose 'Default' to follow your system DNS.
tabConfigDesc1: Pick a preset that matches your activity.
optPresetExt: Each preset is a bundle of network settings tuned for one activity. 'Game' focuses on low ping, 'Download' on max speed. Smart Auto Mode can switch presets for you automatically.
optTcpExt: Controls how your phone sends data. BBR is best for raw speed, Cubic is more stable on weak connections.
tabConfigDesc2: Encrypt your DNS requests with trusted providers.
optDnsExt: Encrypts your DNS requests so your provider can't see which sites you visit. Also helps bypass DNS blocking.
tabConfigDesc6: Sends packets immediately instead of grouping them. Lower ping.
optNicExt: Your phone normally groups small packets together, which adds a tiny delay. Turning this off sends packets immediately — great for games.
tabConfigDesc7: Handles network traffic on the fastest CPU cores only.
optIrqExt: Locks network processing to your phone's fastest CPU cores, so traffic is handled quicker and smoother.
tabConfigDesc9: Gives network threads top priority in the system.
optKsoftExt: Makes the system's network workers run first, even when the CPU is busy with other things.
tabConfigDesc3: Stops background network stats and WiFi scanning.
optNetStateExt: Stops Android from collecting network statistics and scanning for WiFi in the background. This prevents small ping freezes caused by those tasks.
optWifiPsDesc: Keeps WiFi always awake for stable ping. Uses a bit more battery.
optWifiPsExt: WiFi normally sleeps between packets to save battery, which makes ping jump up and down. This keeps it awake for consistent ping. Reapplied automatically after reconnecting.
optConntrackDesc: Stops connections from silently dropping when many apps are online.
optConntrackExt: Your phone keeps a list of all active connections. When the list is full, new connections fail silently. This makes the list much bigger so it never runs out.
tabConfigDesc4: Use IPv4 only for a more stable connection.
optIpv6Ext: Some mobile networks handle IPv6 poorly, causing random lag spikes. Turning this off forces the older but more stable IPv4 path.
tabConfigDesc5: Limits speed and blocks background data. Saves quota.
optDataSaverExt: Limits internet speed and blocks background apps from using data. Useful on limited data plans — avoid it while downloading.
optLangExt: Switch the language used across the PingPimp interface.
optSaveLogDesc: Save the log file to internal storage.
optSaveLogExt: Saves PingPimp's log to /sdcard/PingPimp.log. Useful when reporting issues.
tabIsolateDesc: Block internet access for specific apps to stop background data usage.
tabBoostDesc: Prioritize network traffic for chosen games or apps to reduce lag.
optBannerDesc: Use your own image for the home banner.
optBannerExt: Replace the home banner with your own picture. Supports GIF, JPG, PNG, and WebP up to 5 MB. Resets when the module is updated.
optNavStyleDesc: Swap the fixed bottom bar for a floating bar that hides on scroll.
optNavStyleExt: Off keeps the standard bottom bar, always visible at the bottom of the screen. On switches to a rounded floating bar that hides when you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up.
optMonetExt: Colors automatically match your system's wallpaper theme.
